title: The Buddha Speaks the Sutra on Curing Hemorrhoids

inline.s: Translated by the Tripitaka Dharma Master Yijing of the Tang Dynasty

Thus have I heard. At one time the Bhagavān was dwelling in the Bamboo Grove of the great city of Rājagṛha, together with a great assembly of five hundred bhikṣus. At that time, many bhikṣus were afflicted with the hemorrhoid
zhì
disease, their bodies gaunt
léi
and emaciated, and anguish entangled
yíng

them, so that they suffered grievous distress day and night. At that time the Venerable Ānanda, seeing this, went to the World-Honored One, bowed his head to the Buddha's feet, and stood to one side. He addressed the Buddha, saying: 'World-Honored One! Now in the city of Rājagṛha there are many bhikṣus afflicted with the hemorrhoid disease, their bodies gaunt and emaciated, anguish entangling them, suffering grievous distress day and night. World-Honored One! How may these afflictions be cured?'
[Bhagavān] This is a phonetic rendering, meaning 'World-Honored One.' [World-Honored One] An honorific title of the Buddha, because the Buddha is the one whom all the world reveres together.
[bhikṣu
bì chú

] that is, a monk. One who has left home and received the full ordination is called a bhikṣu if male and a bhikṣuṇī if female. 'Great bhikṣu' describes those monks whose spiritual attainment is very high.

[āyuṣmat, 'the Venerable'] A common title for a bhikṣu, because a bhikṣu possesses not only the lifespan of this world but also the wisdom-life of the Dharma body. [Ānanda] i.e., 'Ānanda,' the shortened form of the fuller transliteration Ānántuó. He was the Buddha's cousin, born on the night of the Buddha's enlightenment, who later left home to become the Buddha's attendant. One of the ten chief disciples, he was renowned for 'never forgetting what he had heard and being foremost in erudition.' [Hemorrhoid disease] In ancient times, cancer was called 'hemorrhoid disease.'

At that time the Buddha said to Ānanda: 'You should listen to this Sutra on Curing Hemorrhoids, recite it, uphold it, and keep it firmly in mind without forgetting; and you should also proclaim it widely to others, so that all these hemorrhoid diseases may be utterly eradicated
tiǎn

. Namely, wind hemorrhoids, heat hemorrhoids, yin hemorrhoids, threefold-combined hemorrhoids, blood hemorrhoids, abdominal hemorrhoids, nasal hemorrhoids, dental hemorrhoids, tongue hemorrhoids, eye hemorrhoids, ear hemorrhoids, crown hemorrhoids, hemorrhoids of the hands and feet, spinal hemorrhoids, and anal hemorrhoids — all the hemorrhoids arising from every joint of the body, and such hemorrhoid fistulas
(zhì lòu)
, shall all dry up, fall away, and be utterly destroyed, and they will surely be cured
chài
beyond doubt. All should recite and uphold such a divine mantra.' Then he spoke the mantra:
[tiǎn] to end, to eradicate. [chài
to recover from illness.

Ānanda! To the north of here stands the great Snow-Mountain King, and within it grows a great śāla tree named Nansheng ('Invincible'), which bears three kinds of flowers
huā
, an old form of 'flower')

: the first, newly born; the second, fully rounded; the third, withered and dry. Just as when those flowers dry up and fall, so shall the hemorrhoid disease that afflicts our bhikṣus be likewise: no more bleeding, no more flowing of pus, all pain forever removed, all made whole again, and then made dry. Moreover, if one constantly recites this sutra, one will attain the wisdom that abides in the knowledge of past lives and be able to recall the events of seven past lifetimes; the mantra practice will be accomplished. Svāhā. Then he spoke another mantra:

When the Buddha had finished speaking this sutra, the Venerable Ānanda and the entire great assembly rejoiced greatly and received and practiced it with faith.
In August 1998, I (Lay Buddhist Miaoguang) was diagnosed at a tumor hospital with a nasopharyngeal tumor.
The only treatment for this disease was radiotherapy. After more than ten sessions of radiation, I deeply felt my bodily functions declining; I had no appetite and could not sleep at night.
Before long, Lay Buddhist Sun Baozhen brought me two copies of the Buddha Speaks the Sutra on Curing Hemorrhoids.

After reading this sutra, I at once thought of the many fellow patients in the hospital, especially the farmers from faraway villages who had borrowed money to come to Beijing for treatment — so many people in truly desperate circumstances.
Unwilling to recite it for myself alone, I donated the funds to print three thousand copies and distributed them to hospitals and temples.
Morning and evening I recited the sutra three times each and chanted each of the two mantras twenty-one times — about ten or so minutes in all.

Before long, the lump on my neck and the blood-streaked mucus I had been drawing back all disappeared, and it has now been two years. I went back only once for a checkup and have never returned to the hospital since.
The stomach-cancer lesion vanished without a trace!
Two months ago, Lay Buddhist Gao Guifen of Baiwanzhuang telephoned with good news:

Huang Cunbao, the in-law of Lay Buddhist Kong Xiulan, had stomach cancer and was admitted to the emergency room of Peking University Hospital, awaiting surgery; but he had other illnesses to treat first, and was also raising funds.

During this time, Kong Xiulan gave a copy of the Buddha Speaks the Sutra on Curing Hemorrhoids to her son to deliver to his father-in-law, and she offered a cup of water before the Buddha for him, reciting the sutra once and the mantra one hundred and eight times before he drank it.
From then on, Huang had bowel movements three times a day.

Within a month, when the hospital examined him again to determine the site for surgery, they found the lesion had vanished without a trace. The doctors could not explain it, saying only that the earlier examination had not been mistaken … and so the operation was called off.
After returning home, Huang Cunbao made a vow to print one thousand copies of this sutra to repay the Buddha's kindness.
Respectfully related by Miaoguang, a junior student of the Pure Karma (Beijing)

Notes:
1. Recite the sutra text at least once and the mantra twenty-one times each day; this can eliminate the suffering of illness and misfortune.

2. When illness or pain arises, offer a cup of holy water before the Buddha, recite and uphold the sutra text once, chant the mantra one hundred and eight times over it, then divide it into two cups. Drink one cup, and use the other to wipe the afflicted area.
3. Be sure to remember: the cup used to make offerings to the Buddhas and Bodhisattvas should be reserved for that purpose alone. You must pour the water into your own cup before drinking it.
A case of curing cancer (the author did not specify what kind of cancer):
After my mother fell ill, we were at first very flustered and helpless
fortunately, I study Buddhism
and was also joining a group practice of the Casket Seal Dharani Sutra
I knew this was an illness brought on by karmic obstruction
so first I recited the Casket Seal Dharani Sutra and mantra for my mother every day, dedicating the merit to her karmic creditors
and moreover, in the past I had inadvertently acquired
Buddha Speaks the Sutra on Curing Hemorrhoids
, this sutra and mantra specifically for curing cancer
for the three days before my mother's surgery I recited this sutra and mantra for her every day
though in truth I had no idea
whether it could really prove so efficacious.
While my mother was in surgery, I stayed outside reciting the holy name of Avalokiteshvara Bodhisattva (Avalokiteshvara) for her the whole time
and the operation went very smoothly
for such a major operation, my mother said the actual surgery took only forty-some minutes
although the cancer that was removed was already very large
and had spread
belonging to the late stage
yet later the doctor said
Strange, the tumor has already separated from the surrounding tissue
and it is quite dry
and it has calcified
very strange.
As soon as I heard this I understood

this is exactly what the Sutra on Curing Hemorrhoids says: “...the third, withered and dry. Just as when those flowers dry up and fall, so too shall the hemorrhoid disease that afflicts our bhikṣus be: no more bleeding, no more flowing of pus, all pain forever removed, all made whole again, and then made dry.
At that moment my blood surged with excitement
the Buddha is truly one who speaks the truth and never deceives — every word is gold, every sentence a treasure
practicing according to the teaching truly brings boundless benefit. My faith in the sutras is now more unshakable than ever
and I believe that practicing according to the teaching can improve my mother's condition.
Because the tumor had dried and sloughed off
my mother bled very little
and recovered very well after the operation
so well that, unless we told them, no one would know she had had surgery
during this period
my mother underwent chemotherapy three times
and after each session she could eat and sleep well
growing plump
with all her lab results perfectly normal
all of this thanks to the teachings of the sutra and everyone's dedication of merit
it was everyone's selfless dedication of merit to my mother
that made it possible for her karmic obstructions to diminish
in the end I sincerely thank everyone
and I hope everyone can benefit for a lifetime from studying Buddhism.
